summary: A manual on loading the pike with field qi for a shock thrust, then bracing to take the answering blow.

summary: Forms for two paired files of pikes that thrust in turn, so the points of one cover the recovery of the other.

summary: A course of stooping hawk thrusts that fall from height onto a foe, taught for the open basin floor.

summary: A doctrine that uses the iron ferrule as a second weapon, paired with the point like two banks of a river.

summary: Teaches wind-sworn pikemen to take a bearing on the foe and hold it with the point across open ground.

title: Oath Thrusts of the Open-Ground Pike
summary: Oath-bound thrusts for a pikeman who stands in the open with no walls behind him and must not yield.

title: Gale Pike Course: Bearing Held Against the Charge
summary: A course in holding the pike's bearing while a gale-fast charge breaks on the point, then pressing the gap.
